description: List the workspace's media files across all folders, newest first. Read-only. Trashed files are not listed - use list_trashed_media. Each file carries its id, name and canonical url - the url is what media fields of records and blocks take. Paginated: while hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set; if hasMore is true but nextCursor is null, page with the offset instead, and past offset 10000 narrow the filter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. The page continues after it in the same filter and sort; leave the skip/offset at 0 when you pass it

limit.description: Files per page, 1-100; values outside are clamped

offset.description: How many rows to skip, at most 10000; page past that with cursor

name: list_media
title: List media
